reasons: IDA 9.2 reports address 1882201908, size 20, 1 basic blocks and 5 instructions.

Linker- and dyld-generated glue, not source. ld emits this body into __TEXT,__text for every MH_BUNDLE it links with lazy symbol pointers, and it jumps through the __DATA,__dyld section that dyld fills in at load. It has no frame pointer, unlike all 34 compiled bodies in this binary, and it is one of only three local symbols the link left in the symbol table (divergences.md, VGA_psdrvr finding 1).

Single-analyzer evidence. angr cannot produce an analysis document for this bundle at all - its CFG recovery aborts with 'block at address 1882209993 is outside function at address 1882210007' - and all 48 of Ghidra 12.1's relocation records come back as r_type == 0 - GENERIC_RELOC_VANILLA, the only relocation kind an i386 image of this era emits - which gives normalize_analysis nothing to derive a field width from. The independent corroboration for this partition is therefore the Mach-O symbol table, section table and relocation table read directly out of the file, not a second disassembler; the agreement status is recorded as partial for that reason (divergences.md, Evidence).

entries.reason: Generated by the NeXT static linker and completed by dyld, not written in any source file. ld synthesises dyld_stub_binding_helper and __dyld_func_lookup when it links an MH_BUNDLE that binds symbols lazily; both indirect through __DATA,__dyld, which is eight zero bytes in the file and is filled in by dyld at load time. Phase 3a writes no counterpart and must not try to.
